messages:
incidents-bot: [PAGER] billing.metering.alert token_count_drift detected for emitter-2 (eu-west1). Delta > 22% vs baseline. Multiple overage flags triggered. Severity: P1. Investigate ASAP. link: https://redwood.incidents/6423456789
marco (oncall): I'm on it — pulling consumer/lag dashboards now. @Ethan can you join?
Ethan - billing-sre: on call, joining. Initial glance: kafka consumer lag ~120k for metering-eu group, partition 3 showing repeated offsets. Also seeing a burst of identical event IDs in the emitter stream.
Priya (CS): FYI — CS has 3 customers who just received overage emails in the last 30m. They're asking if billing is broken.
Jen Infra: checking aggregator pods. aggregator-eu-2 restarted 2 hours ago for a config push (v1.4.2). Rolling logs now.
marco (oncall): action plan draft: 1) pause ledger writes from emitter-2 to stop new false flags 2) enable read-only fallback aggregator 3) rollback producer/aggregator change if config issue 4) run targeted backfill and reconcile 5) notify customers with interim update
ops-bot: command accepted: /incident annotate 6423456789 action_plan_set
Ethan - billing-sre: found evidence of duplicate event IDs with same client_id + seq in a ~18m window. Suspect producer retry loop without idempotence after the v1.4.2 deploy. Sample from logs:
```
2026-03-18T01:12:04Z emitter-2 INFO produced id=evt_0x9a3 client=acct_123 seq=987 payload_size=212
2026-03-18T01:12:04Z emitter-2 INFO produced id=evt_0x9a3 client=acct_123 seq=987 payload_size=212
```
Jen Infra: confirmed: the new deploy removed enable.idempotence=true by mistake. Creating rollback to v1.4.1 image and patching producer config now.
marco (oncall): pausing writes to ledger for emitter-2 now — run: `svc-metering pause-writes --emitter emitter-2`
ops-bot: `svc-metering pause-writes --emitter emitter-2` -> acknowledged by metering-control (txn_id: pause-6423). Writes paused.
Priya (CS): drafting customer note: short heads-up acknowledging noisy overage emails, letting them know we're pausing writes and performing reconciliation; will follow up with final reconciliation timeline. Posting to status.redwood.ai draft channel.
Ethan - billing-sre: starting dedupe/reconcile dry-run (tool: metering-recon v0.9) against ledger snapshot range 01:00-03:00 UTC. Dry-run indicates ~14k duplicate token events that would inflate counts.
Alex PM: do we have an ETA for reducing false overages? Customers want an ETA.
marco (oncall): rollback in progress (eu-west1). Canaries at 10% traffic, monitoring token delta. If canary looks good in 5m, promote.
Jen Infra: canary promoted at +6m, metrics back to baseline for 10% shard. Rolling full rollback now.
ops-bot: rollback job completed for aggregator-producer to v1.4.1 (job-id: rb-6423).
Ethan - billing-sre: producer config patched, idempotence re-enabled. Starting reconciliation pass (fix mode) now. Backfill job scheduled: backfill-6423456789-01. Runs will be staged to avoid billing window overload.
marco (oncall): mitigation summary: writes paused, rollback applied, backfill queued. We will run backfill and then re-run overage flag recalculation.
Priya (CS): sending interim note to impacted customers: short note + offer of manual review. Draft posted and @here pinged.
Ethan - billing-sre: preliminary results from fix pass: duplicate events removed, affected accounts show corrected token deltas. Running final reconciliation — expected completion in ~2.5 hours.
Alex PM: good. Any risk of persistent undercount after backfill?
Ethan - billing-sre: low risk — backfill is idempotent and validated against raw kafka archive. We'll run verification checks `reconcile --verify-checksums` after job completes.
marco (oncall): handoff plan: I'll stay until reconciliation finishing. If I'm offline, hand off to Jen Infra oncall. Leaving note in oncall runbook.
ops-bot: incident status update: severity downgraded to P2 (writes paused, rollback applied).
Priya (CS): updated customers with interim message and expected reconciliation ETA ~3 hours. No billing finalized invoices will be issued until reconciliation completes.
Ethan - billing-sre: postmortem notes to capture: missing idempotence config in deployment, improved deploy validation, add monitoring for duplicate event ID rate, enforce a deploy-time check for producer configs.
marco (oncall): closing loop: once backfill + verification done, we'll unpause writes and lift temporary flags. Tracking checklist in incident ticket: https://redwood.incidents/6423456789/checklist
Alex PM: thanks all — please add the customer list to the ticket so CS can follow up for refunds if needed.
ops-bot: incident 6423456789 — last automated update.
Priya (CS): :thumbsup: keeping CS on standby for customers.
Ethan - billing-sre: final: reconciliation finished, verification passed, unpausing writes in 2m and recalculating overage flags, will confirm when invoices cleared.
ops-bot: writes unpaused -> metering-control (txn_id: unpause-6423).
marco (oncall): confirmed recalculation complete, overage flags cleared for affected accounts. Closing incident. Thanks everyone. :tada:
